loopSuffix: Animate it as a short, smooth, seamlessly looping GIF with clear motion between frames.

prompts.title: Jelly bear wobble
prompts.prompt: A chubby round cartoon bear with a soft jelly-like body and stubby arms, squishing down and springing back up while wobbling side to side, cheeks jiggling on every bounce. Thick clean outlines, flat pastel colors, centered on a plain solid mint-green background that contrasts strongly with the bear.
prompts.tips: Keep the background one flat color far from the character's colors so it can be keyed out as a transparent sticker later.
prompts.tips_zh: 背景用一种和角色颜色完全拉开的纯色，之后才方便抠成透明贴纸。

prompts.title: Bunny thumbs-up
prompts.prompt: A small white cartoon bunny with long floppy ears and a pink nose, giving an enthusiastic thumbs-up with one paw, the paw pumping forward twice while the ears bounce. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain warm yellow background.
prompts.tips: Reuse the same character description across a set (see the next two prompts) so the whole sticker pack stays consistent.
prompts.tips_zh: 一整套表情包都复用同一段角色描述（见后面两条），风格才能保持一致。

prompts.title: Bunny laughing to tears
prompts.prompt: A small white cartoon bunny with long floppy ears and a pink nose, laughing so hard it rocks back and forth, eyes squeezed shut and two little tears flying out. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain warm yellow background.

prompts.title: Sleepy bunny
prompts.prompt: A small white cartoon bunny with long floppy ears and a pink nose, sitting and nodding off, head slowly drooping then jerking back up, a small bubble swelling and shrinking from its nose. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain warm yellow background.

prompts.title: Cartoon cat waving hello
prompts.prompt: A cheerful cartoon cat waving hello.
prompts.tips: Even a one-line prompt works for simple greetings — the model fills in style and timing.
prompts.tips_zh: 简单的打招呼动作，一句话提示词也够用，风格和节奏交给模型。

prompts.title: Confused shiba head tilt
prompts.prompt: A fluffy orange shiba inu puppy tilting its head to one side and back again, ears twitching, a small question mark popping above its head. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain light blue background.

prompts.title: Cat typing furiously
prompts.prompt: A grey tabby cat sitting at a tiny laptop and typing furiously with both front paws, paws blurring, little speed lines and sweat drops flying off. Flat cartoon sticker style, bold outline, plain pale pink background.
prompts.tips: Speed lines and sweat drops make fast motion readable even with only a few frames.
prompts.tips_zh: 速度线和汗珠能让快速动作在帧数很少时也看得清。

prompts.title: Frog blowing a heart
prompts.prompt: A round green cartoon frog puffing its cheeks and blowing a pink heart-shaped bubble that floats up and pops into tiny sparkles. Cute flat sticker style, bold outline, plain cream background.

prompts.title: Penguin facepalm
prompts.prompt: A chubby cartoon penguin slowly raising one flipper and slapping it onto its forehead, then shaking its head in disbelief. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain light grey background.

prompts.title: Basketball shot celebration
prompts.prompt: A chibi kid in a red jersey jumps and shoots a basketball, the ball swishes through the hoop, then the kid lands and pumps a fist in celebration before returning to the starting pose. Bold-outline sticker style, plain light orange background.
prompts.tips: For sports moves, break the action into 3 clear beats (jump, shot, celebrate). Complex tricks like a 360 kickflip still tend to fail.
prompts.tips_zh: 运动类动作拆成三个清楚的节拍（起跳、出手、庆祝）。360 度踢板这类复杂花式目前仍容易失败。

prompts.title: Cat chef tossing fried rice
prompts.prompt: A white cat chef in a tall chef hat tossing fried rice in a wok, the rice flies up in a little arc and lands back in the pan, a puff of steam rising each time. Comic cartoon style, warm kitchen background kept still.

prompts.title: Black cat punch
prompts.prompt: A round black cat with big yellow eyes throwing a quick one-two punch toward the viewer with its front paws, little impact stars popping, then settling back into a boxing stance. Chibi sticker style, bold outline, plain pastel purple background.

prompts.title: Office cat: exhausted
prompts.prompt: A chubby orange tabby cat office worker with a tiny blue tie and an employee badge slumps face-down onto a pile of papers on its desk, ears drooping, a tiny ghost of a sigh floating up, then twitches one paw. Flat cartoon sticker style, bold outline, plain pale grey background.
prompts.tips: Part of a set: repeat the exact same character description and only change the action — that is how real sticker packs stay consistent.
prompts.tips_zh: 成套表情：角色描述一字不改，只换动作，真实上架的表情包都是这样保持一致的。

prompts.title: Office cat: clocking out
prompts.prompt: A chubby orange tabby cat office worker with a tiny blue tie and an employee badge tosses its badge in the air, grabs a tiny backpack and does a happy little hop toward the door, tail swishing. Flat cartoon sticker style, bold outline, plain pale yellow background.

prompts.title: Roaring duck
prompts.prompt: A small round yellow duck suddenly opening its beak wide and roaring like a lion, feathers blown back, the screen shaking slightly, then it calmly closes its beak. Cute cartoon sticker style, bold outline, plain sky-blue background.

prompts.title: Flower macro flash cut
prompts.prompt: A fast flash-cut sequence of eight different flower photographs, one per frame, each filling the whole frame: a red poppy shot from above with light glowing through its petals, a creamy gardenia in soft side light, blue delphinium against a deep blue background, a golden marigold macro, a pink peony from a high angle, a dark purple iris close-up, an orange lily with curled petals, and pale green hydrangea with dew drops. Realistic botanical fashion photography, each frame with a different color, distance and composition.
prompts.tips: Describe every frame as a distinct shot. Changing color, angle and framing between frames is what makes a flash cut feel energetic.
prompts.tips_zh: 把每一帧写成独立的镜头。帧与帧之间颜色、角度、景别差异越大，快闪越有冲击力。

prompts.title: Cat-head logo brand reel
prompts.title_zh: 猫头 Logo 品牌快闪
prompts.prompt: A quick-cut brand reel for a fictional cat food brand called "MEOWBITE". The same flat dark-brown cat-head logo — round face, two short pointed ears, cream almond eyes, short whiskers — stays fixed at the center of every frame while everything around it changes: an orange full-bleed poster, a pink pouch of cat food, a blue ceramic cat bowl seen from above, a kraft shipping box, a round sticker, and a final dark frame with the word MEOWBITE in big cream letters. Bold graphic design, flat colors, citrus orange, cream and dark brown palette.
prompts.tips: Lock the logo's position and size in every frame and only change the surroundings — that is what makes a brand flash read as one identity.
prompts.tips_zh: 每一帧都锁定 Logo 的位置和大小，只换周围的场景，快闪才像同一个品牌。

prompts.title: Sneaker colorway flash
prompts.prompt: A fast flash-cut in a square frame: the same chunky sneaker seen from the side, centered and the same size in every frame, while its colorway and the full-bleed solid background change each frame: white and red on blue, black and lime on pink, cream and brown on orange, purple and silver on yellow, all-white on black. Clean studio product photography, the background fills the whole frame edge to edge.
prompts.tips: Fix the product's angle and position, change only colors — the classic product colorway reel.
prompts.tips_zh: 固定产品角度和位置，只换配色，就是最经典的产品配色快闪。

prompts.title: One tree, four seasons
prompts.prompt: The same lone round tree on a small hill, framed identically in every frame, cycling through the four seasons: pink spring blossoms, lush green summer, orange autumn leaves falling, bare branches in winter snow. Soft flat illustration with a matching sky color for each season.

prompts.title: Magazine collage panels pop in
prompts.prompt: A fashion-magazine collage layout where photo panels pop in one by one — a flower, a pair of sunglasses, a coffee cup, a city skyline — each with a small bounce, and finally a bold title bar reading "WEEKEND" slides in. Clean editorial design, cream background, coral and navy accents.
prompts.tips: Keep the text to one short word; long titles still warp between frames.
prompts.tips_zh: 文字只放一个短单词，长标题在帧间仍会变形。

prompts.title: Reading by the window, day to night
prompts.prompt: A girl with a short bob reading a book on a cushion by a big window, seen from the side. Outside the window the sky cycles from bright morning blue to orange sunset to a starry night and back to morning, while the room light warms up and a desk lamp switches on at night. Soft flat illustration, calm and cozy.
prompts.tips: Day-to-night loops are harder than simple motions. Keep the character mostly still and let the light and sky carry the change.
prompts.tips_zh: 昼夜循环比简单动作难得多。让人物基本保持不动，用天空和光线来表现变化。

prompts.title: Steaming coffee loop
prompts.prompt: A steaming cup of coffee on a small wooden table, steam curling and drifting upward, a tiny spoon wobbling on the saucer. Cozy flat illustration with warm colors.

prompts.title: Rainy window and plant
prompts.prompt: A rainy window at dusk with a small potted plant on the sill, raindrops sliding down the glass and blurry city lights twinkling outside. Soft muted blue palette, lo-fi illustration style.

prompts.title: Goldfish in a bowl
prompts.prompt: A round glass fishbowl on a windowsill with one orange goldfish swimming a slow circle, tail fluttering, tiny bubbles rising to the surface. Soft watercolor-style illustration, gentle light.

prompts.title: Lighthouse at night
prompts.prompt: A white lighthouse on a rocky shore at night, its beam sweeping slowly across a dark blue sky, waves rolling and splashing against the rocks below. Flat illustration with a deep navy and warm yellow palette.

prompts.title: Cat sleeping by the fireplace
prompts.prompt: A ginger cat curled up asleep on a rug in front of a crackling fireplace, its body gently rising and falling with each breath, flames flickering and casting warm light. Cozy flat illustration, warm orange and brown tones.
prompts.tips: Breathing is a great tiny motion for calm loops — it reads clearly and loops naturally.
prompts.tips_zh: “呼吸起伏”这种小动作很适合做安静的循环，看得清又天然能循环。

prompts.title: Lantern monkey in the snow
prompts.prompt: A small monkey in an olive-green hooded coat standing in a snowy pine forest at dusk, lifting a glowing amber paper lantern, looking up and blinking, then lowering the lantern back to where it started. Snow falls gently and a tiny cabin glows in the background. Soft storybook illustration, locked camera.
prompts.tips: Give the subject a pose to return to and lock the camera — the easiest way to get a clean loop.
prompts.tips_zh: 给主体一个能回去的起始姿势，并锁定镜头，循环最容易接得上。

prompts.title: Sleepy fox on a mossy rock
prompts.prompt: A small orange fox curled up asleep on a mossy rock, its tail gently swaying and ears twitching. Soft storybook illustration, locked camera.

prompts.title: Lo-fi study loop
prompts.prompt: A girl with headphones writing in a notebook at a desk at night, her pencil moving, steam rising from a mug, rain sliding down the window behind her and a desk lamp glowing. Lo-fi anime illustration, muted purple and blue palette, locked camera.

prompts.title: Café cinemagraph
prompts.prompt: A cinemagraph of a quiet street café terrace in the morning: everything is perfectly still except the steam curling from a cup on the table and a striped awning flag fluttering in the breeze. Realistic photography, soft warm light, locked camera.
prompts.tips: For a cinemagraph, say explicitly that everything is still except one or two named elements.
prompts.tips_zh: 做动态照片（cinemagraph）要明确写“除了某一两个元素，其他都静止”。

prompts.title: Ink-wash galloping horse
prompts.prompt: A racehorse with a jockey galloping to the right in a loose Chinese ink-wash painting style, legs cycling through a full gallop stride, the jockey bobbing up and down, ink splashes kicking up behind the hooves. Rice-paper background, black ink with a touch of red.

prompts.title: Doodle monster comes alive
prompts.prompt: A crude crayon doodle of a little purple blob monster with two eyes on wobbly stalks and three stubby legs, drawn on lined notebook paper, comes alive: its eye-stalks blink and sway, it waves its tiny arms and hops in place, keeping the wobbly hand-drawn lines and odd proportions. The notebook paper stays still.

prompts.title: Pixel art campfire
prompts.prompt: A pixel art campfire at night in a small forest clearing, flames flickering, sparks rising and fading, two logs glowing orange. 16-bit retro game style, dark blue night sky with a few stars.

prompts.title: Bouncing dots loader
prompts.prompt: A minimal loading animation: three rounded dots in coral, violet and teal bouncing up and down one after another in a wave, with soft squash on landing. Flat vector style on a plain off-white background.
prompts.tips: UI loaders work best with very few elements and a plain background.
prompts.tips_zh: 界面加载动画元素越少越好，背景保持纯色。

prompts.title: Pixel knight run cycle
prompts.prompt: A pixel art knight with a blue cape and a small sword running to the right in a side view run cycle, cape flapping, on a plain dark background. 16-bit retro game sprite style, crisp pixels.
prompts.tips: Ask for a "run cycle" in "side view" to get game-sprite style animation.
prompts.tips_zh: 写明 “side view” 和 “run cycle”，就能得到游戏精灵图那样的动画。

prompts.title: Like button heart burst
prompts.prompt: A rounded outline heart icon that fills with red, pops bigger with a bounce and bursts into small colorful confetti dots around it, then settles back. Flat vector UI animation on a plain white background.

prompts.title: Hourglass loading
prompts.prompt: A simple flat hourglass icon with sand pouring from the top to the bottom, then the hourglass flips over and starts again. Minimal vector style, teal frame and golden sand on a plain off-white background.

prompts.title: Arcade VS screen
prompts.title_zh: 街机对战 VS 画面
prompts.prompt: A retro arcade versus screen: on the left a chubby panda wrestler in a yellow cape, on the right a lanky girl skateboarder with a green ponytail and a hoodie, both slide in from the edges, a huge "VS" slams into the center with lightning flashes, then both strike a pose. 16-bit pixel art, bold colors.
prompts.tips: Use clearly original characters (animals, unusual outfits). Generic "martial artist in a headband" drifts toward famous fighting-game heroes.
prompts.tips_zh: 用一眼就是原创的角色（动物、少见的服装）。写“头戴发带的武术家”这类泛称，容易画成知名格斗游戏主角。

prompts.title: 8-bit slime boss battle
prompts.prompt: An 8-bit boss battle: a giant green slime boss with a tiny crown bounces and squishes in the center of a dungeon arena, its health bar at the top flashing, while a small pixel hero on the left raises a shield. Retro NES pixel art, dark stone background.

prompts.title: Love-burst skill animation
prompts.prompt: A chibi magical girl with a pink bob raises her wand and casts a "love burst" skill: a ring of glowing pink hearts explodes outward from her and fades, then she returns to her idle pose. Game skill-card style animation, sparkly effects, dark purple background.

prompts.title: Junkyard robot walk cycle
prompts.prompt: A rusty little scrap-metal robot with one antenna and a mismatched arm walking to the right in a side-view walk cycle, bolts jiggling, a puff of dust at each step. Pixel art game sprite on a plain dark background, crisp pixels.

prompts.title: Chibi trader watching stocks crash
prompts.title_zh: Q 版上班族看股价暴跌
prompts.prompt: A chibi office worker in a white shirt and loose tie staring at a laptop where a red stock line plunges, his hopeful smile crumbling into big wobbling tears. Flat pastel sticker style on a plain light background.

prompts.title: Chibi trader celebrating a rally
prompts.title_zh: Q 版上班族看股价暴涨
prompts.prompt: A chibi office worker in a white shirt and loose tie jumping up from his chair as a green stock line shoots upward on his laptop, throwing paper banknotes into the air with both hands. Flat pastel sticker style on a plain light background.

prompts.title: Cat in sunglasses dancing
prompts.prompt: A cool grey cat wearing tiny black sunglasses doing a side-to-side groove dance, hips swaying and one paw pointing up then down. Bold cartoon sticker style on a plain yellow background.

prompts.title: Top-hat frog shooing bad vibes
prompts.prompt: A small green frog in a tall black top hat and a monocle waving a tiny cane in circles as if shooing away bad luck, little grey smoke puffs scattering. Cute storybook sticker style on a cream background.

prompts.title: Busy bee clocking in
prompts.prompt: A round fuzzy cartoon bee with a tiny lanyard badge buzzing in place, wings fluttering fast, then giving a crisp salute. Soft flat sticker style on a plain mint background.

prompts.title: Puppy swaying with hearts
prompts.prompt: A fluffy cream-colored puppy sitting and swaying its head left and right with its eyes closed happily, small pink hearts floating up around it. Kawaii sticker style on a plain white background.

prompts.title: Goodnight kitty
prompts.prompt: A sleepy white kitten in a blue nightcap hugging a small pillow, slowly yawning and then nodding off as a tiny crescent moon bobs beside it. Soft pastel sticker style on a dark navy background.

prompts.title: Orange cat pouncing at the camera
prompts.prompt: A chubby orange cat crouching, wiggling its rear, then leaping straight toward the viewer with paws spread wide until its face squishes against the glass. Funny cartoon style on a plain living room background.

prompts.title: Laughing so hard it cries
prompts.prompt: A round pink mochi blob character throwing its head back and laughing hysterically, tears spraying from its eyes, body shaking. Cute sticker style on a plain white background.

prompts.title: Apprentice spell backfires
prompts.prompt: A chibi wizard apprentice in an oversized purple hat waves a wand, a small puff explodes in front of her, and she is left blinking with a soot-black face and frizzy hair. Cute cartoon sticker style on a plain lilac background.

prompts.title: Cat baker sneezes flour
prompts.prompt: An anthropomorphic orange cat in an apron kneading dough on a wooden counter, then sneezing and blowing a big white cloud of flour into the air. Warm cartoon style.

prompts.title: Lobster working overtime
prompts.prompt: A red cartoon lobster wearing round glasses typing furiously on a keyboard with both claws at a desk late at night, lit by the blue glow of a monitor, a coffee mug steaming beside it. Cartoon sticker style.

prompts.title: Penguin panics after hitting send
prompts.title_zh: 按下发送后慌了的企鹅
prompts.prompt: A small cartoon penguin slapping a big round red button labeled "SEND", then freezing as its eyes go wide and it grabs its head with both flippers in panic, sweat drops flying. Flat sticker style on a plain white background.

prompts.title: Otter in a teal scarf waving
prompts.prompt: A small brown sea otter with a cream muzzle and a teal knitted scarf turning toward the viewer, waving one paw twice and blinking. Soft sticker style on a plain cream background.

prompts.title: Office worker: received!
prompts.prompt: A chibi office worker with a tidy bob and a lanyard snapping to attention and giving a firm thumbs-up with a determined nod. Flat sticker style on a plain light blue background.

prompts.title: Cat flying on a broomstick
prompts.prompt: A black cat with a tiny red scarf riding a wooden broomstick across a night sky, bobbing up and down, the scarf fluttering behind it. Cute storybook sticker style.

prompts.title: Baby robot wave and hop
prompts.prompt: A tiny round white baby robot with a glowing blue face screen and stubby legs waving one hand and doing a small happy hop, its antenna wobbling. Clean 3D toy style on a plain pastel background.

prompts.title: Hamster stuffing its cheeks
prompts.prompt: A golden hamster sitting up and stuffing sunflower seeds into its cheeks until they balloon comically, then blinking proudly. Cute cartoon style on a plain white background.

prompts.title: Duckling with a tiny umbrella
prompts.prompt: A yellow duckling holding a tiny red umbrella hopping in a small puddle, splashes rising with each hop while rain falls. Soft watercolor sticker style.

prompts.title: Paper airplane desk to notebook
prompts.title_zh: 纸飞机从桌面滑到笔记本
prompts.prompt: An orange paper airplane with one navy stripe lifting off a wooden desk, gliding in a gentle arc and landing on an open notebook beside a pencil. Fixed camera, soft daylight, realistic photo style.

prompts.title: Neon OPEN sign flicker
prompts.title_zh: 霓虹 OPEN 招牌闪烁
prompts.prompt: A pink and blue neon "OPEN" sign in a dark shop window at night, buzzing and flickering on letter by letter, then glowing steadily. Realistic photo style.

prompts.title: Light sweep over a product
prompts.prompt: A frosted glass skincare bottle standing still on a beige stone plinth while a soft diagonal band of light sweeps slowly across the background from left to right. Minimal product photography.

prompts.title: Perfume bottle spinning on water
prompts.prompt: A square amber perfume bottle labeled "SOL" slowly rotating on the surface of still water, rings of ripples spreading out, warm sunset reflections. Luxury product photography.

prompts.title: Two-line event title reveal
prompts.prompt: A bold two-line title "SUMMER" and "MARKET 2026" sliding in from the left one line after the other on a sunny orange background, with small confetti pieces popping. Clean flat motion graphics.

prompts.title: Chat bubbles popping in
prompts.prompt: A phone chat screen where three message bubbles pop in one by one: grey "Are you done yet?", blue "Almost!", grey "Send it!". Clean flat UI style on a white background.

prompts.title: City jumps a thousand years
prompts.prompt: The same riverside city skyline from a fixed viewpoint changing era by era: low brick buildings, then glass towers, then floating platforms with glowing sky bridges. Cinematic matte painting style.

prompts.title: Tiny people building a sandwich
prompts.prompt: A team of miniature people in aprons on a full-size kitchen table hauling a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice and a cheese square onto a giant slice of bread using ropes and a tiny ladder. Tilt-shift macro photo style.

prompts.title: Castle rising stone by stone
prompts.prompt: A medieval stone castle on a green hill building itself up from the foundation: walls rise, towers grow, then flags pop up on top. Fixed camera, isometric storybook illustration.

prompts.title: Same fox in six materials
prompts.title_zh: 同一只狐狸换六种材质
prompts.prompt: The same sitting fox in the same pose, each frame rendered in a different material: felt, paper cut, risograph print, pixel art, glossy Y2K chrome, clay. Centered, identical framing, plain background.

prompts.title: Teapot steam turns into a heart
prompts.prompt: A copper teapot on a windowsill on a rainy afternoon, steam rising from the spout and briefly curling into a heart shape before drifting apart. Clay stop-motion style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Husky howling in a snow globe
prompts.title_zh: 雪花球里嚎叫的哈士奇
prompts.prompt: A tiny husky inside a glass snow globe sitting on a snowy mound and howling up at the sky as glitter snow swirls around it. Product photo style on a dark wooden table.

prompts.title: City in a snow globe
prompts.prompt: A snow globe holding a miniature city of red-brick apartment blocks and a little yellow taxi, snow drifting down slowly inside the glass. Warm studio lighting, macro photo.

prompts.title: Clay kitten in a ball pit
prompts.prompt: A clay kitten popping its head out of a ball pit full of colorful plastic balls, balls tumbling off its head as it wiggles. Claymation style.

prompts.title: Pelican riding a bicycle
prompts.prompt: A pelican riding a red bicycle along a seaside promenade, legs pedaling and its big beak bobbing, waves rolling in behind. Flat vector illustration, side view.

prompts.title: Windmill on green hills
prompts.prompt: A white wooden windmill on rolling green hills, its four sails turning slowly while clouds drift across a blue sky. Soft painterly landscape.

prompts.title: Paper boat bobbing on water
prompts.prompt: A white folded paper boat bobbing gently on calm water, small ripples spreading outward, fixed overhead camera. Soft natural light photo style.

prompts.title: Robot dancing on the street
prompts.prompt: A boxy orange robot doing a robotic pop-and-lock dance on a graffiti-covered city street, arms snapping between poses. Fixed camera, vibrant 3D render.

prompts.title: Chopping wood in winter
prompts.prompt: An old man in a thick wool coat raising an axe and splitting a log on a stump in a snowy backyard, wood halves falling to the sides, his breath visible in the cold air. Painterly illustration.

prompts.title: Petting a shiba in the rain
prompts.prompt: A girl with a clear umbrella crouching on a wet city street at night to pet a shiba inu, the dog's tail wagging, rain glittering under neon reflections. Anime-style illustration.

prompts.title: Canyon waterfall mist
prompts.prompt: A tall waterfall pouring into a deep green canyon pool, mist rising and ripples spreading across the water. Fixed wide shot, realistic landscape photo.

prompts.title: Glass butterfly with shifting shadows
prompts.prompt: A butterfly made of clear glass perched on a white table, slowly opening and closing its wings while the colorful refracted shadow on the table changes in sync. Macro photo, soft light.

prompts.title: Glowing beaker vortex
prompts.prompt: A glass lab beaker on a dark bench with a swirling vortex of glowing teal liquid inside, tiny bubbles rising and the glow pulsing. Moody lab photography.

prompts.title: Eagle flapping its wings
prompts.prompt: A golden eagle flying in place with powerful wing beats, feathers rippling, isolated on a plain sky-blue background. Realistic illustration.

prompts.title: Paper lantern Jiangnan with koi
prompts.prompt: A layered paper-cut lantern scene of a southern Chinese water town with a stone arch bridge and a pavilion, two golden koi swimming beneath the bridge while the warm light flickers. Paper-sculpture style.

prompts.title: Clay dough baker mascot
prompts.prompt: A round clay dough mascot in a little white chef hat kneading a piece of dough on a floured board, folding it over and giving a small wave. Claymation style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Robot barista pouring coffee
prompts.prompt: A small white robot barista with one arm pouring steamed milk into a cup of coffee on a café counter, drawing a leaf pattern in the foam. Clean 3D render.

prompts.title: Pixel hero sword slash
prompts.prompt: A pixel art hero with spiky red hair swinging a sword in a wide arc, leaving a bright white slash trail. Side view game sprite on a plain dark background, crisp pixels.

prompts.title: Handheld-style castle run
prompts.prompt: A 32-bit handheld-style side-scrolling level: a small round armadillo knight in shiny orange armor with a feathered helmet running and jumping across castle battlements while the background parallax scrolls. Pixel art.

prompts.title: Squash and stretch bouncing ball
prompts.prompt: A red rubber ball bouncing on a flat floor with classic squash and stretch, a soft shadow growing and shrinking underneath. Clean flat animation on a plain white background.

prompts.title: AI assistant typing indicator
prompts.prompt: A chat interface where a small rounded robot avatar sits beside a grey bubble with three dots pulsing one after another, the avatar's eyes blinking. Clean modern UI style on white.

prompts.title: 16-bit fighter punch combo
prompts.prompt: A 16-bit arcade fighter, a stocky red panda in a blue gi, throwing a jab and a straight punch from a fighting stance with hit sparks. Side view sprite on a dojo background.

prompts.title: Train wind on the platform
prompts.prompt: A girl with long dark hair and a yellow raincoat standing on a subway platform as a train rushes past behind her, her hair and coat whipping sideways in the gust while she squints. Anime film still style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Gym bear doing chest presses
prompts.prompt: A muscular cartoon brown bear in a red tank top lying on a bench and pressing a barbell up and down, cheeks puffing with each rep. Bold cartoon sticker style on a plain grey background.

prompts.title: Cat dozing in a VR headset
prompts.title_zh: 戴 VR 眼镜打瞌睡的猫
prompts.prompt: A fluffy grey cat wearing a sleek white VR headset slowly nodding off, its head drooping and jerking back up, a small Zzz bubble floating up. Soft 3D render on a plain lavender background.

prompts.title: Grateful shrimp bows deeply
prompts.prompt: A small pink cartoon shrimp pressing its claws together, raising them high over its head and then bowing dramatically low, with the caption "THANK YOU!" fixed at the bottom. Flat sticker style on a white background.

prompts.title: Paper crane takes off from a card
prompts.prompt: A folded white paper crane sitting on an open greeting card flaps its creased paper wings and lifts off, rising gently above the card. Soft pastel watercolor style on a cream background, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Mantis shrimp jiggles a flan
prompts.prompt: A rainbow-colored cartoon mantis shrimp poking a caramel flan on a plate with both front claws, the flan wobbling wildly while the shrimp's eyes sparkle with delight. Glossy clay-toy style on a pale yellow background.

prompts.title: Gift box with a pop-up ghost
prompts.prompt: A glossy red cartoon gift box with a gold ribbon: the lid pops open and a tiny round white ghost springs out on a coiled spring, bouncing with a jelly-like wobble. Soft rounded 3D render on a mint background, square 1:1.

prompts.title: Ring of fire spell
prompts.prompt: A glowing circular magic sigil on dark stone floor ignites into a ring of orange flames that swirl around its edge while embers drift upward. Stylized anime game effect, top-down three-quarter view, dark background.

prompts.title: Lightning in a jar
prompts.prompt: A corked glass jar on a wooden table with a tiny bolt of blue-white lightning crackling inside, flashing and branching against the glass and lighting up the table. Painterly fantasy style, dim room.

prompts.title: Water spiral orb
prompts.prompt: A floating sphere of clear water with a spiral current turning inside it, small droplets orbiting around and catching light. Anime game skill effect on a deep teal background.

prompts.title: Ice crystal bloom
prompts.prompt: A pale blue ice crystal growing from the center of the frame, frost branches spreading outward like a snowflake and sparkling, cold mist curling at the edges. Anime game effect on a dark navy background.

prompts.title: Gorilla shuffle dance
prompts.prompt: A chunky cartoon gorilla wearing a tiny red bow tie doing a side-to-side shuffle dance, swinging its long arms and bobbing its head to the beat. Flat vector sticker on a white background.

prompts.title: Bowl-cut dog scrolling
prompts.prompt: A small dog with a perfectly round bowl-cut hairstyle lying on its belly, scrolling a smartphone with one paw and snorting with laughter at the screen. Cute cartoon style on a white background.

prompts.title: Baby seal: shocked
prompts.prompt: a chubby white baby harp seal with big glossy black eyes, pink cheeks and a tiny blue scarf jolting backward in shock, eyes popping wide and whiskers standing straight out, with a small burst of exclamation lines. Flat chat-sticker style on a white background.
prompts.tips: For a set, reuse the exact same character description in every prompt.
prompts.tips_zh: 做成套表情时，每条都复用完全相同的角色描述。

prompts.title: Baby seal: sneaky giggle
prompts.prompt: a chubby white baby harp seal with big glossy black eyes, pink cheeks and a tiny blue scarf covering its mouth with one flipper and giggling, shoulders shaking and eyes curved into happy arcs. Flat chat-sticker style on a white background.
prompts.tips: For a set, reuse the exact same character description in every prompt.
prompts.tips_zh: 做成套表情时，每条都复用完全相同的角色描述。

prompts.title: Baby seal: giving up
prompts.prompt: a chubby white baby harp seal with big glossy black eyes, pink cheeks and a tiny blue scarf lying flat on its belly and slowly melting into a puddle-like blob, then sighing a tiny cloud. Flat chat-sticker style on a white background.
prompts.tips: For a set, reuse the exact same character description in every prompt.
prompts.tips_zh: 做成套表情时，每条都复用完全相同的角色描述。

prompts.title: Baby seal: crying
prompts.prompt: a chubby white baby harp seal with big glossy black eyes, pink cheeks and a tiny blue scarf bawling with its mouth wide open, two streams of tears spraying out sideways, flippers flapping. Flat chat-sticker style on a white background.
prompts.tips: For a set, reuse the exact same character description in every prompt.
prompts.tips_zh: 做成套表情时，每条都复用完全相同的角色描述。

prompts.title: Baby seal: sending love
prompts.prompt: a chubby white baby harp seal with big glossy black eyes, pink cheeks and a tiny blue scarf lifting both flippers together over its head to form a clear heart shape, then small pink hearts float up. Flat chat-sticker style on a white background.
prompts.tips: Two-limb heart gestures often fail to close; spell out that the flippers meet above the head.
prompts.tips_zh: 双手比心经常合不拢，要写明两只鳍在头顶碰在一起。

prompts.title: Shiba: on it, on it
prompts.prompt: A cream shiba inu at a desk typing furiously on a keyboard with both paws, sweat drops flying off its head, with the handwritten caption "在改了在改了" fixed at the top. Flat sticker style on a white background.

prompts.title: Shiba takes a snowball
prompts.prompt: A shiba inu in a red knitted winter hat standing in the snow gets hit in the face by a snowball, snow bursting everywhere, then blinks and shakes its head. Cartoon sticker style on a pale blue background.

prompts.title: Tuxedo cat vs. foxtail toy
prompts.prompt: A simple black-and-white anime-style tuxedo cat sitting up and swatting at a foxtail grass toy dangling from above, ears flattened, tail twitching. Clean line art on a white background.

prompts.title: Bodyweight squat guide
prompts.prompt: A clean flat infographic of a faceless fitness figure in a teal tank top doing a bodyweight squat in side view: sitting the hips back with arms stretched forward, then standing tall. Light grey background with a dotted guideline at knee height.

prompts.title: Hamster courier
prompts.prompt: A small golden hamster in a tiny brown courier cap pushing a cardboard parcel twice its size across the floor, cheeks puffed with effort and feet scrabbling. Cozy cartoon sticker on a white background.

prompts.title: Grandma in her Sunday hat
prompts.prompt: A cheerful cartoon grandma in a big floral Sunday hat and a pearl necklace clapping and swaying side to side to music, eyes closed in joy. Warm flat illustration on a soft pink background.

prompts.title: Tang court dancer
prompts.prompt: A court dancer in flowing red and gold Tang-dynasty robes spinning in place, her long water sleeves trailing in wide arcs around her. Painted in the style of ancient Chinese cave murals on a warm ochre background.

prompts.title: Cardboard robot breakdance
prompts.prompt: A robot made from cardboard boxes with bottle-cap eyes doing a breakdance toprock step, then dropping into a one-hand freeze on a flattened cardboard mat. Hand-drawn marker style on white paper.

prompts.title: Comic halftone action poster
prompts.prompt: A bold comic-style action poster: a masked fox thief in a long red coat leaps across the frame while red, black and white halftone burst rays pulse behind and speed lines flash. Graphic print style.

prompts.title: House cutaway reveal
prompts.prompt: An isometric 3D cutaway of a small two-story house: the front wall slides away to reveal tiny furnished rooms, and the lights switch on room by room. Soft clay render on a light blue background.

prompts.title: Neon star with light trail
prompts.prompt: A neon sign shaped like a five-pointed star, outlined in orange-pink LED dots, glowing against a dark starfield while a thin comet-like light trail orbits around it and small stars twinkle.

prompts.title: 8-bit raver alien
prompts.prompt: 8-bit pixel art of a little green alien wearing antenna headphones, jumping and pumping its fist on a tiny dance floor while colored strobe lights flash. Retro game palette, black background.

prompts.title: Corgi begs for a snack
prompts.prompt: A fluffy corgi mascot staring up at a treat just above its head, drooling, wiggling its round butt and doing a little hop. Cute vector sticker on a white background.

prompts.title: Dramatic poodle faint
prompts.prompt: A white poodle mascot striking a dramatic pose, pressing a paw to its forehead and swooning backward onto a red velvet cushion. Exaggerated theatrical cartoon on a cream background.

prompts.title: Steam over fresh sourdough
prompts.title_zh: 刚出炉的酸面包冒热气
prompts.prompt: A freshly baked sourdough loaf on a floured wooden board, still except for thin curls of steam rising from its scored crust. Warm morning light, food photography, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Pixel coffee cup
prompts.prompt: A pixel-art coffee cup on a saucer with three wisps of steam rising and curling in a loop. 16-bit style, warm brown palette, plain cream background.

prompts.title: Cat stretching on the windowsill
prompts.prompt: An orange tabby cat on a sunny windowsill stretching its front legs, yawning wide, then settling back and blinking slowly. Soft watercolor illustration, curtains still, fixed camera.

prompts.title: White cat and yarn ball
prompts.prompt: A fluffy white kitten batting a red yarn ball, rolling onto its back with the ball in its paws, then popping back upright. Soft pastel cartoon on a pale lavender background.

prompts.title: Flower-crown cat dance
prompts.prompt: A grey cat wearing a crown of small daisies doing a happy side-step dance on its hind legs, front paws swinging. Flat cute illustration on a light green background.

prompts.title: Ripples on a dawn lake
prompts.prompt: A calm mountain lake at dawn, everything still except soft ripples spreading across the water and a thin layer of mist drifting slowly over the surface. Photorealistic landscape, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Scroll-down arrow hint
prompts.prompt: A minimalist rounded chevron arrow pointing down, bouncing gently up and down with a soft shadow that shrinks and grows beneath it. Flat UI style, indigo on white.

prompts.title: Raincoat kid big jump
prompts.prompt: A chibi kid in a yellow raincoat crouching down, springing into a high jump with arms up, then landing with a little puff of dust. Side view, flat animation style on a white background.

prompts.title: Mug colorway cycle
prompts.prompt: A single ceramic coffee mug shown whole and centered in a square frame, handle to the right, on a seamless white studio backdrop. Only the mug's glaze color changes from frame to frame — coral, sage green, navy, mustard, lilac — while its shape, position, shadow and lighting stay exactly the same.
prompts.tips: Colorway cycles come back as one frame per color (5 here). Our first try was cropped with seams; asking for the whole mug centered fixed it, but the output became a tall 350×883 strip, so crop it to square if needed.
prompts.tips_zh: 换色展示会按颜色出帧（这里 5 帧）。第一次画面被裁、有接缝；写明整只杯子居中后修好了，但输出变成 350×883 的竖长条，需要的话再裁成方图。

prompts.title: Tote bag feature callouts
prompts.prompt: A product shot of a natural canvas tote bag; small glowing circle markers with plus icons appear one after another on the front pocket, the leather handle and the inner divider. Clean studio photography on beige.

prompts.title: Pixel lantern scares ghosts
prompts.prompt: 16-bit pixel art of a kid in a hooded green cloak raising a glowing lantern in a moonlit graveyard, and three small round cartoon ghosts flee off to the right. Side view, retro game style.

prompts.title: Paper-cut river valley
prompts.prompt: Layered paper-cut art of a river valley: paper waves slide across, a little paper fishing boat bobs on them, and paper clouds drift, with soft shadows between the layers. Pastel blue and green palette.

prompts.title: Gem merge game ad
prompts.prompt: A mobile puzzle game ad shot: two identical glowing blue gems slide together on a grid board and merge into one bigger gem with a burst of sparkles and a floating "+100". Bright casual-game style.

prompts.title: Mochi says OK
prompts.prompt: A round white mochi character with tiny arms bowing politely and then popping up holding an "OK!" sign, cheeks blushing. LINE-sticker style with thick outlines on a white background.

prompts.title: Snail mail delivery
prompts.prompt: A small snail with a tiny leather postbag slowly sliding forward and holding out an envelope with its antennae, smiling proudly. Soft storybook illustration on a cream background.

prompts.title: Surprised toast pops up
prompts.prompt: Two slices of toast with cartoon faces popping out of a chrome toaster, flipping in the air with surprised expressions, then dropping back in. Glossy 3D cartoon on a pale orange background.

prompts.title: Cactus wants a hug
prompts.prompt: A small potted cactus character opening its spiky arms wide for a hug, then looking down at its spines and drooping sadly. Flat cute illustration on a white background.

prompts.title: Axolotl blows a bubble
prompts.prompt: A pink axolotl with frilly gills puffing its cheeks to blow a round bubble that grows, pops, and leaves it blinking in surprise. Soft cartoon style, light aqua background.

prompts.title: Glowing jellyfish
prompts.prompt: A single translucent jellyfish drifting in the deep ocean, its bell pulsing slowly and its tentacles trailing as soft cyan bioluminescence glows along its edges. Dark blue water, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Candle on a writing desk
prompts.prompt: A lit candle on an old wooden writing desk beside an open notebook and fountain pen, still except for the flickering flame and its soft shifting glow on the paper. Moody painterly style.

prompts.title: Pixel treasure chest
prompts.prompt: 16-bit pixel art treasure chest: the lid flips open, gold coins and a gem burst upward with sparkles, then settle back inside. Retro RPG style on a dark dungeon floor.

prompts.title: Rocket progress bar
prompts.prompt: A flat UI progress bar filling from left to right as a tiny cartoon rocket flies along its leading edge, leaving a sparkly trail. Clean vector style, purple and white.

prompts.title: Sun / moon theme toggle
prompts.prompt: A rounded toggle switch sliding from a sunny yellow side with a sun icon to a dark navy side with a crescent moon and tiny stars. Flat UI style on a light grey background.

prompts.title: Sushi conveyor belt
prompts.prompt: A sushi conveyor belt in a small restaurant with colorful plates of nigiri sliding steadily from left to right past the counter. Warm anime background art style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Sloth wakes up with coffee
prompts.prompt: A sleepy sloth hanging from a branch slowly sipping coffee from a tiny cup, then its eyes pop wide open with sparkles. Soft cartoon sticker on a white background.

prompts.title: Lifting ramen noodles
prompts.prompt: A bowl of ramen with a soft-boiled egg and green onions, chopsticks lifting a bundle of noodles that sway gently while steam rises. Rich anime food illustration, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Frog puddle jump
prompts.prompt: A small green frog in a red raincoat leaping into a puddle, water splashing up in a crown, then giving a happy little wave. Bright cartoon style on a white background.

prompts.title: Spinning vinyl record
prompts.prompt: A vinyl record spinning on a wooden turntable with the tonearm resting on it, warm lamp light reflecting off the grooves, small music notes floating up. Cozy lo-fi illustration, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Bunny rolling on the floor crying
prompts.title_zh: 在地上打滚大哭的兔子
prompts.prompt: A chubby cream-colored cartoon bunny lying on its back on the floor, kicking its little legs and rolling side to side while sobbing, big cartoon tears flying off both sides. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain pale pink background.

prompts.title: 90s anime gasp
prompts.title_zh: 90 年代动画风倒吸一口气
prompts.prompt: A 1990s cel-animation style girl with two long auburn braids, a band of freckles across her nose, round glasses and a green denim jacket gasping in shock: her eyes go wide behind the glasses, a big sweat drop appears beside her head, then her shoulders drop. Soft film grain, VHS-era color palette, plain lavender background.
prompts.tips: Name the decade and medium (cel animation, film grain, VHS palette) and keep the character design generic so it doesn't drift toward a known show.
prompts.tips_zh: 写明年代和画法（赛璐珞、胶片颗粒、VHS 色调），角色外观保持通用，避免被画成某部现成动画的角色。

prompts.title: 90s anime blush
prompts.prompt: A 1990s cel-animation style boy with messy brown hair and a red scarf blushing: pink hatched lines spread across his cheeks, he looks away and scratches the back of his head. Soft film grain, VHS-era color palette, plain peach background.

prompts.title: Otter holding a thank-you sign
prompts.prompt: A small brown cartoon otter holding up a little wooden sign that reads "THANK YOU", bowing forward and popping back up with a happy squint, tiny hearts floating above. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain mint background.
prompts.tips: Short words in quotes usually stay legible; check every frame for letter changes.
prompts.tips_zh: 引号里的短词一般能保持清晰，仍要逐帧检查有没有字母走样。

prompts.title: Shrimp saved by a recovered file
prompts.title_zh: 文件找回后喜极而泣的小虾
prompts.prompt: A small pink cartoon shrimp in a tiny office lanyard hugging a glowing blue folder icon to its chest, crying tears of relief and bouncing up and down with joy. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain white background.

prompts.title: Panda resting on a cushion
prompts.prompt: A chubby cartoon panda leaning back on a big round yellow cushion, slowly closing its eyes and letting out a long relaxed sigh, a small "zzz" drifting up. Soft watercolor texture, gentle outlines, plain cream background.

prompts.title: Hedgehog hugging a sweet potato
prompts.prompt: A tiny cartoon hedgehog hugging a roasted sweet potato almost as big as itself, steam rising from the cracked skin, the hedgehog taking a happy nibble and wiggling. Crayon doodle style on plain off-white paper.

prompts.title: Caveman shrug
prompts.prompt: A stocky cartoon caveman with a wild orange beard, a bone hair clip and a spotted fur tunic shrugging with both palms up and an unimpressed face, eyebrows bouncing once. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain sand-colored background.

prompts.title: Too many emails, close laptop
prompts.title_zh: 邮件太多，默默合上电脑
prompts.prompt: A cartoon office worker with round glasses opening a laptop, the screen showing a red badge with a huge unread count, their face going pale, then slowly closing the laptop again. Exaggerated expressions, thick outlines, flat colors, plain light grey background.

prompts.title: Smug raccoon says no thanks
prompts.title_zh: 得意地摆手说不用了的浣熊
prompts.prompt: A smug cartoon raccoon in pink heart-shaped sunglasses lounging in a beach chair, sipping a juice box and lazily waving one paw in a "no thanks" gesture, eyebrows raised. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain sky-blue background.

prompts.title: Monday desk slump
prompts.title_zh: 周一瘫在桌前的胖橘猫
prompts.prompt: A chubby orange cat wearing a navy necktie slumping over a laptop, sinking lower and lower until it disappears behind the desk, then popping back up with a tired face. The word "MONDAY." printed above in bold letters. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain white background.

prompts.title: Collapsed souffle tears
prompts.prompt: A chibi baker girl in a white apron pulling a tall souffle out of the oven, the souffle sinking flat, her eyes filling with tears, then she shrugs and takes a spoonful. Soft pastel cartoon, plain warm beige background.
prompts.tips: Four beats (pull out, collapse, cry, eat) fit a 6-frame sprite sheet; more beats make each step blur together.
prompts.tips_zh: 四个节拍（拿出、塌掉、哭、吃）正好放进 6 帧；节拍再多，每一步都会变得模糊。

prompts.title: Tabby cat double take
prompts.prompt: A calm orange tabby cat sitting sideways, then suddenly turning toward the viewer: its eyes go huge, ears shoot up, mouth drops open, then it settles back to calm. Clean cartoon style, plain pale yellow background.

prompts.title: Capybara: OK
prompts.prompt: a round brown cartoon capybara with a small orange yuzu balanced on its head, sleepy half-closed eyes and a calm smile, thick clean outlines, flat pastel colors, plain cream background. The capybara slowly raises one stubby paw into an OK sign and nods once, the yuzu wobbling on its head.
prompts.tips: All four capybara entries share the exact same character description so the set stays consistent.
prompts.tips_zh: 四条水豚共用一模一样的角色描述，整套才能保持一致。

prompts.title: Capybara: sleepy nod
prompts.prompt: a round brown cartoon capybara with a small orange yuzu balanced on its head, sleepy half-closed eyes and a calm smile, thick clean outlines, flat pastel colors, plain cream background. The capybara's head slowly droops forward as it dozes off, then jerks back up, the yuzu nearly falling off.

prompts.title: Capybara: cheering
prompts.prompt: a round brown cartoon capybara with a small orange yuzu balanced on its head, sleepy half-closed eyes and a calm smile, thick clean outlines, flat pastel colors, plain cream background. The capybara waves two tiny pom-poms above its head and bounces, small sparkles popping around it.

prompts.title: Capybara: hot spring
prompts.prompt: a round brown cartoon capybara with a small orange yuzu balanced on its head, sleepy half-closed eyes and a calm smile, thick clean outlines, flat pastel colors, plain cream background. The capybara sits up to its chin in a small round hot spring, steam curling up, eyes closing in bliss as it sinks slightly lower.

prompts.title: Koala jolted awake
prompts.prompt: A sleepy grey cartoon koala hugging a giant mug, nodding off until its nose dips into the coffee, then jolting wide awake with spiky fur. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain soft green background.

prompts.title: Duckling in big headphones
prompts.title_zh: 戴大耳机摇头晃脑的小鸭
prompts.prompt: A fluffy yellow duckling wearing oversized purple headphones, eyes closed, bobbing its head and tapping one foot to the beat, small music notes floating around. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain lilac background.

prompts.title: Tortoise: on my way
prompts.prompt: A green cartoon tortoise with a tiny backpack running as fast as it can, legs spinning in a blur with speed lines and sweat drops, but barely moving forward. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain white background.

prompts.title: Raccoon finds a treasure
prompts.title_zh: 从纸箱里探出头炫宝的浣熊
prompts.prompt: A grey cartoon raccoon popping up out of a cardboard box holding a shiny silver spoon high above its head, eyes sparkling proudly, a little gleam flashing on the spoon. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain orange background.

prompts.title: Dinosaur tiny-arm clap
prompts.prompt: A chubby mint-green cartoon dinosaur trying hard to clap with its very short arms, the paws barely reaching, its face scrunched in effort, then a proud grin. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain peach background.

prompts.title: Owl side-eye
prompts.prompt: A round brown cartoon owl perched on a branch, slowly turning its eyes sideways toward the viewer and raising one feathery eyebrow in suspicion, then blinking once. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain teal background.

prompts.title: Cloud sneezes rain
prompts.prompt: A small fluffy white cloud character with rosy cheeks scrunching up its face and sneezing, a burst of raindrops and a tiny rainbow shooting out, then sniffling. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain sky-blue background.

prompts.title: Pug blows out a candle
prompts.prompt: A pug in a striped party hat puffing its cheeks and blowing out a single candle on a pink cupcake, the flame going out and colorful confetti popping up. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain yellow background.

prompts.title: Alpaca hair flip
prompts.prompt: A fluffy white cartoon alpaca with a huge curly fringe tossing its head to flip the fringe out of its eyes, then posing with a confident wink. Thick outlines, flat colors, plain pink background.

prompts.title: Picture-book bunny watering flowers
prompts.prompt: A children's picture-book page in soft watercolor and colored pencil: a little bunny in blue overalls watering a row of tulips with a tin can, water drops falling, two butterflies fluttering around. Gentle healing mood, fixed camera.
prompts.tips: Picture-book style works well for calm kids' videos; keep only one or two small moving parts.
prompts.tips_zh: 绘本风适合做治愈系儿童短视频；画面里只让一两个小东西动。

prompts.title: Diwali oil lamps
prompts.prompt: A row of small clay diya oil lamps on a stone step decorated with a colorful rangoli pattern, their flames flickering, warm light pulsing softly, a few marigold petals drifting down. Warm festive night, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Ink-wash moonlit window
prompts.prompt: A Chinese ink-wash painting of a moonlit round window with a pipa lute leaning against the sill, plum blossom petals drifting past, thin clouds sliding across the full moon. Muted ink tones on rice paper, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Palm shadow on a travel journal
prompts.prompt: An open travel journal on a sunny café table with taped photos and a handwritten page, the soft shadow of a palm frond drifting slowly across the pages and back. Everything else stays still. Warm film-photo colors, fixed overhead camera.

prompts.title: Astronaut with a paper star
prompts.title_zh: 屋顶上捧纸星星的宇航员
prompts.prompt: A small astronaut sitting on a city rooftop at night holding a folded paper star, the star starting to glow, lifting gently out of their gloves, floating up a little and drifting back down. Dreamy illustration, deep blue sky, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Bonsai with fireflies
prompts.prompt: A small bonsai pine in a ceramic pot on a wooden shelf at dusk, a few fireflies drifting around its branches and blinking on and off. Soft painterly style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Swaying kelp forest
prompts.prompt: An underwater kelp forest with tall golden-green kelp swaying in the current, sun rays shimmering down from the surface, a small school of silver fish darting past. Fixed camera.

prompts.title: View from a train window
prompts.prompt: The view through a train window on a sunny afternoon: green rice fields and distant hills scrolling past, telegraph poles flicking by, a cup of tea on the windowsill rippling slightly. Anime-inspired background painting, fixed camera inside the carriage.

prompts.title: Whisking matcha
prompts.prompt: A bamboo whisk briskly whisking bright green matcha in a dark ceramic bowl, fine foam forming on top, a wisp of steam rising. Close-up on a wooden tray, soft natural light, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Aurora over a cabin
prompts.prompt: A small wooden cabin with glowing windows in a snowy valley, green and violet aurora ribbons rippling slowly across the starry sky above, smoke curling from the chimney. Fixed camera.

prompts.title: Hot-air balloons at sunrise
prompts.prompt: Several colorful hot-air balloons drifting gently over a canyon at sunrise, the nearest one's burner flaring briefly, morning mist moving below. Soft golden light, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Cherry blossoms over a stone bridge
prompts.prompt: An arched stone bridge over a quiet stream lined with cherry trees in full bloom, pink petals falling and landing on the water, ripples spreading. Soft spring light, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Roasting a marshmallow
prompts.prompt: A marshmallow on a stick held over a campfire at night, slowly turning golden brown, the flames flickering and small sparks floating up. Close-up, warm firelight, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Paper collage night scene assembles
prompts.prompt: A paper collage on a blank cream page: torn paper pieces slide in one by one to build a night city skyline, then a pair of scissors snips out a paper moon that settles into the sky. Craft texture, visible paper edges, fixed camera.
prompts.tips: For B-roll, decide the visual metaphor and the final still first, then ask for the pieces to assemble from blank.
prompts.tips_zh: 做口播 B-roll 时，先定画面隐喻和最终静帧，再让画面从空白一块块拼出来。

prompts.title: Fictional logo reveal
prompts.prompt: A minimal logo reveal on a deep green background for a fictional tea brand called "LEAF & CO": a single leaf line draws itself, a circle closes around it, the wordmark fades in below, then a soft glow sweeps across. Clean vector style.

prompts.title: Floating headphones product shot
prompts.prompt: A pair of matte white over-ear headphones floating above a round pedestal, slowly turning a quarter turn and bobbing gently while a soft coral rim light glows behind. Studio product shot, plain gradient background, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Citrus bottle splash
prompts.prompt: A glass bottle of orange juice with a plain unbranded label standing in the center, orange slices and water droplets bursting outward around it and falling back, the bottle staying perfectly still. Bright summer studio shot, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Lipstick twisting up
prompts.prompt: A lipstick in a plain smooth rose-gold cylindrical case with no logo, letters or markings, standing on a marble surface: the red bullet twists slowly up out of the case and a light glint slides across the metal. Luxury beauty product shot, soft shadows, fixed camera.
prompts.tips: Say "no logo, letters or markings" on products; otherwise the model may invent a real brand's monogram.
prompts.tips_zh: 产品类要写明“no logo, letters or markings”，否则模型可能自己画出真实品牌的字母标。

prompts.title: Minimal watch close-up
prompts.prompt: A minimalist wristwatch with a white dial lying on a linen surface, the second hand sweeping around, a band of light passing over the glass. Clean product photography, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Earth Online: morning commute
prompts.prompt: A 16-bit pixel art RPG scene of a tired office worker character walking to a bus stop, a game HUD on top: the stamina bar slowly draining, a "+10 EXP" popup rising, and a quest box saying "Survive the commute". Retro game UI, fixed camera.
prompts.tips: Treating everyday life as a game HUD (stamina, EXP, quest box) is a popular series format.
prompts.tips_zh: 把日常生活画成游戏界面（体力条、经验值、任务框）是很受欢迎的系列玩法。

prompts.title: Pixel fishing catch
prompts.prompt: 16-bit pixel art of a kid in a straw hat on a wooden pier, the bobber dipping, the kid yanking the rod up and a shiny fish flipping out of the water with a little sparkle. Retro game palette, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Pixel town in the rain
prompts.prompt: Pixel art of a small town street at night in the rain, raindrops falling, warm windows flickering on, a neon noodle-shop sign buzzing and puddles rippling. Cozy retro game palette, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Pixel crops sprouting
prompts.prompt: 16-bit pixel art farm plot with three rows of soil: sprouts pop up, grow leaves and turn into ripe carrots and pumpkins, a small sparkle appearing over each. Retro farming game style, fixed camera.

prompts.title: Notification bell ringing
prompts.prompt: A flat rounded yellow notification bell icon swinging side to side as if ringing, a red badge with the number 3 popping onto its corner, small motion lines around it. Clean UI icon style, plain white background.

prompts.title: Battery charging icon
prompts.prompt: A flat rounded battery icon filling up segment by segment from red to green, a white lightning bolt pulsing in the middle, a small check mark appearing when full. Clean UI icon style, plain dark background.

prompts.title: Download arrow turns into a check
prompts.prompt: A flat UI animation: a blue down arrow drops into a rounded tray, the tray fills with a progress line, then the arrow morphs into a white check mark inside a green circle. Clean vector style, plain white background.
